tools.name: search_coins
tools.description: Search MONETEKA's catalogue of Ukrainian coins and banknotes by name and facets. Each result carries the coin_id the other coin tools take.

tools.name: get_coin_details
tools.description: Retrieve the facts, photos and description of one identified coin. `fact_status` says per field whether it is official (NBU), set by an editor, unconfirmed, disputed or unknown.

tools.name: get_coin_prices
tools.description: Return the current reference prices of one coin and its bounded observed market price history.

tools.name: get_catalog_entity
tools.description: Explain a coin series, a credited artist or sculptor, or a catalogue year, and list its coins. Covers «coins of the series X», «coins by the artist X» and «coins of 2024», and returns series and person ids.

tools.name: compare_coins
tools.description: Compare two to four identified coins by the same facts and the same price basis.

tools.name: get_related_coins
tools.description: Find a few coins related to one coin (same series, otherwise same year) and say how they are related.

tools.name: get_coin_links
tools.description: Return the canonical MONETEKA website page and the Telegram Mini App link of one coin.

tools.name: get_moneteka_profile
tools.description: Return the signed-in person's MONETEKA profile: an opaque profile id, the display name and the date they joined.

tools.name: get_my_collection
tools.description: List the signed-in person's own coins or their individual purchases, with the collection totals. view=lots returns each purchase with the lot_id and revision that a correction or removal of it needs.

tools.name: get_collection_analytics
tools.description: Explain the signed-in person's collection: its current value, cost and profit, the standout coins, how complete each coin series is, how the value changed over time, or what it held day by day in a period. A missing price is reported as missing, never estimated.

tools.name: get_account_capabilities
tools.description: Say which MONETEKA features the signed-in person's account has, which permissions this connection was given, and where the account settings are.

tools.name: prepare_moneteka_action
tools.description: Validate and preview one action on the signed-in person's account: a new purchase, a correction or removal of one purchase, wanting coins, no longer wanting a coin, a wanted coin that was bought, a message to MONETEKA support, or a change of a public link. Nothing changes and nothing is sent here. T

tools.name: add_collection_lot
tools.description: Save the new purchase that prepare_moneteka_action previewed and the user approved.

tools.name: update_collection_lot
tools.description: Apply the previewed and approved correction to exactly one existing purchase.

tools.name: remove_collection_lot
tools.description: Remove exactly the one purchase that was previewed and that the user explicitly agreed to delete.

tools.name: get_my_wishlist
tools.description: List the coins the signed-in person wants, with their notes, the revision a change needs, and an estimate of what the list costs at known market prices.

tools.name: add_wishlist_items
tools.description: Add the previewed and approved coins to the wishlist; coins already owned or wanted are reported, not added.

tools.name: remove_wishlist_item
tools.description: Remove exactly the one wanted coin that was previewed and that the user agreed to remove.

tools.name: acquire_wishlist_coin
tools.description: Record the previewed and approved purchase of a wanted coin: it becomes one purchase in the collection and leaves the wishlist.

tools.name: get_my_support
tools.description: List the signed-in person's own conversations with MONETEKA support, or read one of them with the answers.

tools.name: send_support_message
tools.description: Send to MONETEKA support the message that was previewed and whose exact text the user approved.

tools.name: get_sharing_settings
tools.description: Say whether the signed-in person's collection or wishlist has a public link, whether the page is open, and what a guest sees there. Reading never creates or changes a link.

tools.name: manage_public_share
tools.description: Apply the previewed and approved change to the public link of the collection or the wishlist: create it, change what guests see, pause, resume, replace or delete it.

tools.name: render_moneteka_view
tools.description: Show coins with MONETEKA's own photos, prices and links, or the account panel. `tool` names the MONETEKA read tool whose answer is shown (search_coins, get_coin_details, get_catalog_entity, compare_coins, get_related_coins, get_coin_prices, get_my_collection, get_my_wishlist or get_collection_analyt
